capabilities: mark start and end positions for a fold
fold text between start and end marks
fold selected text via commands or context menu
remove individual marks or all marks
extras: Not listed in the community plugin market yet; installation is manual or via the BRAT plugin installer.
problem: Obsidian's Live Preview only folds built-in structures like headings and lists, not arbitrary text ranges the user chooses.
summary: Editor folding tool that lets users mark arbitrary start and end positions and fold any text between them in Live Preview.
